text:
📍 Angel Falls, Venezuela 🇻🇪

The world’s tallest uninterrupted waterfall plunges 979m from a tabletop mountain in Canaima National Park.

Its water can turn to mist before reaching the ground below.

Would you journey into this remote wilderness?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Venezuela #AngelFalls

📍 Ilhéu de Vila Franca do Campo, Azores, Portugal 🇵🇹

This volcanic islet hides a nearly circular lagoon connected to the Atlantic by a narrow opening.

Its turquoise waters make it a unique spot for swimming and snorkeling. Would you visit?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Azores #Portugal

📍 Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Abu Dhabi 🇦🇪

White marble domes, reflective pools and intricate floral designs make this landmark unforgettable.

It features 82 domes and one of the world’s largest hand-knotted carpets. 

Would you visit?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #AbuDhabi #UAE

📍 Cliffs of Moher, County Clare, Ireland 🇮🇪

Towering up to 214m above the Atlantic, these dramatic cliffs stretch for 8km along Ireland’s west coast.

Seabirds circle overhead as waves crash far below.

Would you walk along the edge?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Ireland #CliffsOfMoher

📍 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia 🇲🇾

The iconic Petronas Twin Towers rise 452m above the city, linked by a skybridge between floors 41 and 42.

Their gleaming steel façades dominate the skyline.

Would you visit the observation deck?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #KualaLumpur #Malaysia

📍 Poulnabrone Dolmen, County Clare, Ireland 🇮🇪

This ancient stone tomb stands on the rocky Burren landscape, dating back around 5,000 years.

Archaeologists found remains of at least 33 people buried beneath it.

Who built it—and why? 

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Ireland #History

📍Bay of Kotor, Montenegro 🇲🇪

Dramatic mountains plunge into deep blue water, surrounding medieval towns and red-roofed villages.

Often called Europe’s southernmost fjord, this bay is actually a submerged river canyon.

Would you explore it by boat?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Montenegro #Kotor

📍Hamnøy, Lofoten Islands, Norway 🇳🇴

Red fishing cabins cling to rocky shores beneath towering mountains, with the Sea stretching beyond.

Once a fishing village, Hamnøy is now one of Norway’s most photographed scenes.

Would you visit in winter?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Norway #Lofoten

📍Fort Amherst Lighthouse, St. John's, Newfoundland, Canada 🇨🇦

At the entrance to St. John’s Harbour, this lighthouse marks a rugged stretch of Atlantic coastline.

Nearby cliffs and crashing waves make the setting unforgettable.

Would you visit?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Newfoundland #Canada

📍 Shirakawa-go, Gifu, Japan 🇯🇵 

Traditional gassho-zukuri farmhouses wear thick blankets of snow, their steep roofs built to shed heavy winter snowfall.

This UNESCO-listed village looks like a winter fairytale.

Would you stay overnight?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Japan #Shirakawago

📍 White Sands National Park, New Mexico, USA 🇺🇸

Endless white gypsum dunes stretch across the desert, creating a landscape that looks almost otherworldly.

The sand stays surprisingly cool underfoot.

Would you explore these dunes? 

#Travel #TravelPhotography #NewMexico #USA
